speaker: Doctor
text: Welcome, please describe your symptoms in detail. You mentioned postmenopausal bleeding and an adnexal mass; have you noticed any pain, pressure, or changes in your urinary habits? Also, have you experienced weight loss, night sweats, or fever recently?

speaker: Patient
text: 65-year-old woman. The patient presents with a 2-month history of intermittent postmenopausal bleeding. She denies any recent weight loss, fever, or changes in bladder or bowel habits. No previous history of similar symptoms. She has no history of serious illness and takes no medications regularly.

speaker: Doctor
text:
DIAGNOSIS READY: Endometrial hyperplasia or endometrial carcinoma.

I will request a Transvaginal ultrasound to evaluate the thickness of the endometrial lining and characterize the adnexal mass further. Please confirm if you have a history of unopposed estrogen exposure, such as hormone replacement therapy or obesity.
